{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Verify premises
premise_1 = df['customer_segment'].isin(['loyal']).any()
premise_2 = df['converted'].isin([0, 1]).all()
premise_3 = set(df['customer_segment'].unique()) == {'new', 'returning', 'loyal'}

# Print premise results
print(f'Premise 1 (loyal exists): {premise_1}')
print(f'Premise 2 (converted is 0/1): {premise_2}')
print(f'Premise 3 (valid segments): {premise_3}')

# Confirm loyal segment values
print(f'Unique customer_segment values: {df["customer_segment"].unique()}')

# Filter for loyal customers only (per contract: all rows where customer_segment == "loyal")
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Check for QA orders and refunded orders in loyal segment
qa_filter = loyal_df['revenue'] == 999999.99
refunded_filter = loyal_df['status'] == 'refunded'

qa_in_loyal = qa_filter.sum()
refunded_in_loyal = refunded_filter.sum()

# Compute conversion fraction on full loyal population
n_loyal = loyal_df.shape[0]
converted_loyal = loyal_df['converted'].sum()
conversion_fraction = converted_loyal / n_loyal

# Print results
print(f'Number of loyal customers (per contract): {n_loyal}')
print(f'Number converted: {converted_loyal}')
print(f'Conversion fraction: {conversion_fraction}')
print(f'QA orders in loyal segment: {qa_in_loyal}')
print(f'Refunded orders in loyal segment: {refunded_in_loyal}')"}
